name: Open the vessel card, follow the ship and read its details (signed in, v2)
description: Validates the vessel card opened from the ship's name: its figures at the replay moment and their basis, Follow switching to the Vessel view, and Ship details opening Ship mode with the ship's identity.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T14:00Z and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Click the ship's name "Eagle S" (data-testid open-vessel-card) in the panel on the right of the 3D view (click "Show panel" first if it is folded)

Assert a card (data-testid vessel-card) opens with "Eagle S" and "Oil tanker, 228.6 m, Cook Islands flag", shows a speed in kn and a course, says "Between two placed positions", and the URL query has layer=vessel
Assert that button now reads "Stop following" and is pressed, "Vessel" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch), and the camera button "Follow the ship" is pressed
Click "Ship details" in the vessel card
Assert the vessel card closes, "Ship" is pressed in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch), and the ship card (data-testid ship-card) shows "Cook Islands", "IMO 9329760" and "MMSI 518998865"
